main_text.p: vita S. Onuphrij. Petrus Argiuorum Episcopus Laudatione in SS. Anargyros Cosmam, & Damianum. Philippus Hymnodus Canone in S. Iosaphatum. Philotheus Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus in Officio Palamæ, Canone in S. Ioannem Damascenum, Orat. in S. Anysiam Thessalonicensem, Laudatione in S. Demetrium Martyrem. Orat. in tres Hierarchas Basilium, Gregorium, & Ioannem Chrysostomum, Orat. in Demetrium Martyrem. Orat. in omnes Sanctos. Photius Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus, Oratione prima de Processione Spiritus sancti, In Bibliotheca in excerptis Chrysostomianis. Photius Sceuophylax, & Logotheta in Encomio sancti Lucilliani. Procopius Diaconus, & Sceuophylax magnæ Ecclesiæ Constantinopolitanæ, in Laudatione S. Marci Euangelistæ, In Laudatione sancti Ioannis Apostoli. Simeon Thessalonicensis, Dialogo contra Hærefes. Simeon Metaphrastes in vitis sancti Charitonis, sancti Cyriaci Anachoretæ, S. Nicolai Myrhorum Episcopi, S. Ioannis Chrysostomi, S. Matthæi Apostoli, & Euangelistæ, sancti Sampsonis Xenodochi, S. Callinici, sancti Marcelli Monasterij Acoemetarum, S. Indi, S. Eugeniæ. Theodorus Coetonita, Canone in Ioannem Eu.

page.notes: Right edge shows partial letters of the neighbouring page's text (gutter edge); not transcribed. "Anyfiam" and "Thessalonicensem" are printed with long s and read as Anysiam and Thessalonicensem; "Thessalo-" is broken at the line end as "Thessalo-/nicensem", transcribed here as the whole word. The final word "Eu." is cut at the gutter and may be "Eu-"; reading uncertain. The "cha-" below the last line is a catchword.
